mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in industrial production exceeds 5%, it signals strong demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following the INDPRO trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate, defined as a decline of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, signals an improving labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of 3-month periods following the UNRATE trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals strong demand in the housing market that will boost related sectors and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following the HOUST trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in nonfarm payrolls exceeds 200,000, it signals strong job growth that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following the PAYEMS trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI is rising faster than 3% year-over-year, it signals building inflationary pressures that will drive the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of months following the CPI trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP is declining and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of months when both GDPC1 is declining YoY and UNRATE is rising.
